name: Waveshare UPS Module 3S · bare holder
description: 93 × 60 mm PCB, fitted empty three-cell holder. Removable cells, cables and acrylic panels are separate items.

catalog.sourceName: Waveshare wiki, dimension drawing and 2022 STEP envelope

geometryEvidence.summary: Manufacturer PCB outline 93 × 60 × 1.6 mm, 86 × 46 mm mounting pitch and holder envelope 77.8 × 60 mm extending 21.5 mm below the PCB.
geometryEvidence.limitations: Reconstructed holder channels, electronics, cell-seat positions and connector envelopes. The vendor STEP has a filled holder envelope and D3.1 bores; the wiki calls the holes D3.0. Upper electronics height is a conservative authored 5 mm allowance above the PCB.

specifications.label: Battery support
specifications.value: 3 × 18650 in series, cells not included; cell length must be less than 67 mm

specifications.label: Mounting
specifications.value: 86 × 46 mm pitch; D3.0 nominal wiki, D3.1 in manufacturer STEP

specifications.label: Output
specifications.value: 5 V / 5 A; 3.3 V / 300 mA; battery series voltage
